sourceWindows: CURRENT: Pitchfork's September 3 MUTEK report and September 9 reviews were inspected for fresh experimental-electronic movement. Honeydrip and Super Galaxy Meow Meow lacked exact-track evidence suitable for this resolver request; Bitchin Bajas and Mykki Blanco were excluded because their exact current tracks were already evaluated in Runs 101 and 114. https://pitchfork.com/story/mutek-is-the-avant-garde-electronic-party-for-the-people and https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/bitchin-bajas-isle-peaks-ep

ADJACENT / EMERGING CATALOGUE: Pitchfork's Rey Sapienz & The Congo Techno Ensemble review was inspected as an untouched Hakuna Kulala / Nyege Nyege-linked broken-electro and percussion window; Santonge and Dancehall Pigme survive on exact-track descriptions. https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/rey-sapienz-the-congo-techno-ensemble-na-zala-zala

OVERLOOKED RHYTHMIC DECONSTRUCTION: Lee Gamble's Mnestic Pressure, Errorsmith's Superlative Fatigue, and Ziúr's U Feel Anything?/ATØ were inspected for short-form deconstruction, slippage, negative-space and bodily percussion; seven exact titles survive. https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/lee-gamble-mnestic-pressure, https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/errorsmith-superlative-fatigue, https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/ziur-u-feel-anything and https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/ziur-ato
FRESHNESS CHECK: current canonical, rejected, revisit, target-local discovery and 224-track utility state contain no prior artist-title decision for the nine requested identities.
exclusions: Canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, untriggered PARKED revisits, existing utility discoveries and unresolved prior leads without materially new identity evidence were excluded.

Runs 110–115 selected artist and label ecosystems were not retried; the scan moved away from SHERELLE/KAY BE, Lara Sarkissian/P. Adrix, KAVARI/Overmono/Sote, Skrillex/Daphni/Sam Prekop, Helena Hauff/Mykki Blanco and Demdike Stare/Autechre/Laurel Halo.
Current-source entries without an exact track-level route were inspected but did not become leads; catalogue age was not treated as a defect.
No Spotify connector, audio-feature inference or invented identity was used.
